==== Item Timer & Charges Display ====
by Vizyne
credit to Grobyc for some feature suggestions



== WHAT THIS DOES ==
- Adds a display above inventory item names that shows their remaining time/charges.

- Raises the collectible/pickup text on screen to avoid overlap with time/charges display.

I recommend using this with the "Gauntlet Dark Legacy: Unofficial Revision Patch" by CyberNomadic. It moves the inventory text up so that it no longer displays over the power meter.
This code was built around the new positioning of the inventory text from that patch.


== KNOWN ISSUES ==
None


== HOW TO USE ==
There are three different versions you can use depending on how you want the timer display to look.
Just add & enable one of the codes.



== CODES ==
Gecko Codes:

Version 1 - Timer/Charge display only shows when an item is turned on.
